question: persister
prompt:
Research question: "What measurements or analyses would best reveal why a small fraction of genetically identical cancer cells survive targeted drug treatment?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Time-lapse imaging to persistence with retrospective tracking
ideas.description: Continuously image a labeled population from before drug addition through the emergence of surviving colonies, tracking every lineage. Then work backward from the survivors to quantify what distinguished them beforehand: cell cycle phase at treatment onset, division history, size, motility, and local neighbor density.

ideas.title: Paired pre- and post-treatment profiling of the same clone via split-population barcoding
ideas.description: Transduce cells with heritable expressed barcodes, split into treated and untreated arms, and sequence both. Barcodes enriched among survivors identify which clones were primed, and single-cell transcriptomes of their untreated counterparts reveal the pre-existing expression state responsible.

ideas.title: Fluctuation-style assay to separate heritable priming from stochastic coin-flips
ideas.description: Expand many independent small subpopulations from single cells, then treat each identically and count survivors. Large clone-to-clone variance in survivor number indicates a heritable, epigenetically transmitted predisposition, while Poisson-like variance points to a transient, cell-autonomous event at the time of treatment.

ideas.title: Chromatin accessibility and histone-mark mapping of survivors versus naive cells
ideas.description: Apply single-cell ATAC-seq and CUT&RUN for repressive and enhancer marks to drug-naive cells, early survivors, and cells after drug withdrawal. This tests whether survival depends on pre-opened enhancers at stress or lineage-plasticity genes and whether that state is reversible.

ideas.title: Signaling and metabolic state reporters measured live at single-cell resolution
ideas.description: Engineer fluorescent reporters for pathway reactivation (ERK or AKT kinase activity), mitochondrial apoptotic priming, and redox or lipid-peroxidation state, then image them in individual cells across treatment. Correlating reporter trajectories with each cell's fate shows whether survival reflects incomplete target inhibition, a high apoptotic threshold, or a distinct metabolic dependency.
